## Current verification and review readiness — 2026-11-23

This bounded source recovery and source-binding repair is **Ready for review** at `96a2f9b7b7a70130b91b837e1aa9bfc491d8c4ce`. This continuation independently re-ran all three original Node test files (**21/21**, no skips), the complete frozen-ledger integrity check, and both actual generator CLIs. The generated snapshot and decisions remain byte-identical to the original archived artifacts (SHA-256 `e27a20141287b63ff39334b44111ee322831d12083f405eac400c3607ba1544d` and `b09eaa9cc7e5635af8486f4d2e2f0e85ec1587370c842041cc32dcb52342c532`). All nine previously reviewed source-file hashes still match.

- [x] **Restore original source/history without changing the frozen data.**
- [x] **Repair the demonstrated manual-reading and archive-index binding defects.**
- [x] **Re-execute the original 21-case suite, complete 1,697-record integrity check and byte-exact generator replay on the published source.**
- [x] **Public-document validation: 305 bilingual routes, 435 maintained documents, zero errors.**
- [x] **Native DCO and live Ready state verified for this head.**
- [ ] Formal independent GitHub approval and integration remain pending.

The original #1147 history-decision acceptance remains **0/1,697** and its 0.4 bookkeeping disposition stays open. Ready applies to this restoration/repair PR; it does not approve the historical decisions. The full scheduled CI jobs were skipped by the existing PR policy and are not represented as passing. First missing-dependency setup failures were retained before the successful fixed-toolchain rerun.

<summary>Preserved earlier Draft record</summary>

## Why

The previous Sprint 7 session left #1147's complete historical source archive in two unpublished commits and its audit tools/snapshots in an old working tree. This Draft restores those sources on main `38afc8942bfd245e12eaa661298c2feddbc63af8` and repairs the source-binding errors found during independent review. The existing [0.4 bookkeeping disposition](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/issues/1147#issuecomment-6684398558) remains unchanged.

## Source preservation

Initial restoration `d8da090538873fefd555753f60d3fce69f3cbee9` retained all **17 original files byte-for-byte**. Original signed commits `b42fd96b279787c8c9a6fb39a2a88f30918cec89` and `56362cea090710530685d12ca516405abec7ceb3` remain recoverable from a complete 15,842,049-byte Git bundle in ordered volumes, with original authors, committers, signoffs, trees and raw commit identities. The connected continuation commits have different SHAs and rewrite no published history.

The frozen snapshot, all 1,697 decisions and original bundle volumes remain byte-identical after the repair. Membership is fixed at **2026-11-22T10:22:30Z**, not today's live population. Original-at-creation edits and inaccessible/deleted sources remain explicit gaps.

## Source-binding repair

Current head: `96a2f9b7b7a70130b91b837e1aa9bfc491d8c4ce`.

- A manual-reading label is inherited only when its original body/discussion hashes match the actual frozen object and cutoff-filtered, ID-sorted discussion. Missing proof, missing objects and duplicates reject.
- A snapshot substitutes the indexed archive only after comparing the complete native RAW capture set and each parsed source-value digest.
- The decoder returns hashes of the exact index buffers used for the decoded data. Both the generator and snapshot reader use that same result, preventing index A from being checked before replacement B is loaded or bound.

Checks run before a generator writes its output. The original failure, first repair attempt and original frozen sources remain preserved.

## Actual verification

- **21/21** focused tests passed with no skips. Independent source review and independent 21/21 execution closed HIST-GEN-001/002 for the exact nine reviewed file hashes; a second reviewer independently checked the decoder/reader and ran its 3/3 focused tests.
- The actual index-replacement fixture fails against the original reader at `d8da090...` (`source-b` instead of `source-a`) and passes with the repair.
- Both complete generator CLIs replayed the **1,740 original native captures** and original **50 manual-reading records**. Snapshot and decision gzip outputs match the preserved originals byte-for-byte.
- Two actual CLI drift controls exited **1** and left their output paths absent.
- The complete integrity check reports **1,697 objects = 467 Issues + 1,230 PRs**, **8,106 comments**, **4,128 inline comments**, one excluded later object and 1,697 reconciled records.
- **Independent decision acceptance stays 0/1,697.** The actual `ready` command still exits **1**. Fifty historical reading records are not 1,697 new manual reviews.
- Public-doc, agent-operations/contributor-skill structure and Agent-document checks passed. The initial unchanged Agent-operations suite passed **1,549/1,549**; the isolated worktree's original missing-`zod` failure and successful dependency-link retry are retained.

[Initial preservation map and logs](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/tree/d8da090538873fefd555753f60d3fce69f3cbee9/internal/records/evidence/2026-11-22-sprint7-history-continuation) · [Current source hashes, replay/negative evidence and independent receipts](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/tree/96a2f9b7b7a70130b91b837e1aa9bfc491d8c4ce/internal/records/evidence/2026-11-22-sprint7-history-source-binding)

## Remaining scope

Continue genuinely independent historical decision review and each source-bound execution condition. Native CI/DCO/review/merge/closure observations remain source facts, not current technical acceptance. No Issue closure, merge, new product/native-browser/model acceptance, ownership takeover or lifecycle promotion is performed here. The local independent receipts are bounded source reviews, not formal GitHub APPROVE submissions.
